tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thanks for taking the time today. Let’s start with your own experience. Think about the first time you watched or participated in a debate competition. What made you interested in that event? What surprised you most about how the debate was conducted?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你今天抽空参与面试。我们先从你的个人经历聊起。回想你第一次观看或参加辩论赛的场景，是什么让你对这项活动产生了兴趣？辩论赛的举办形式中，最让你感到意外的是什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great. Debating affects people differently. Some thrive on the pressure of arguing against others—they find it exciting to defend their ideas. Others feel anxious about debating, worrying they’ll make mistakes or be judged. How do you react when you’re in a debate situation? Why do you think that is?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。辩论对不同人的影响各不相同。有些人在与他人辩论的压力下能充分发挥实力 —— 他们觉得为自己的观点辩护很有成就感。也有些人会对辩论感到焦虑，担心自己出错或被他人评判。当你处于辩论场景中时，会有怎样的反应？你认为原因是什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Okay. Now, here’s a common argument: Some people believe that debate teams should focus only on “serious” topics, like politics or environment, rather than popular culture or social trends. Do you agree with this? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：好的。接下来是一个常见的争议点：有人认为辩论队应该只关注 “严肃” 话题，比如政治、环境相关议题，而不是流行文化或社会趋势类话题。你同意这种观点吗？为什么同意或不同意？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Last question. Debate skills—like public speaking or logical reasoning—are often said to be useful beyond the team. In your opinion, what’s one real-life situation where debate skills would be most helpful? Explain how those skills would make a difference.
tasks.analysis: 中文：最后一个问题。辩论技能 —— 比如公开演讲、逻辑推理能力 —— 通常被认为在辩论队之外也大有裨益。在你看来，哪一种现实生活场景中，辩论技能会最有帮助？请说明这些技能会如何发挥作用。
tasks.title: Interview
